text:
Sofia Martin: Heads-up — Glyph Health renewal in 2 weeks. They're asking to increase committed usage from 100k -> 300k tokens/mo and want a temporary 20% credit for the ramp period. Also requesting a 2-week Dedicated POC (VPC + tenant isolation) before signing. Need deal-desk + security + legal on this. cc @Raj Patel @Liam O'Connor @Sophie Nguyen :eyes:

Raj Patel: Can support the Dedicated POC but need exact scope. What model sizes, expected concurrency, and whether KV cache persistence required? Also any PHI handling?

Liam O'Connor: 20% credit is large. Can we structure as a timeboxed promotional credit + tiered rates instead of permanent discount? e.g., first month blended rate, then standard commit pricing. I'll run numbers if we get the expected token curve.

Sophie Nguyen: Customer is processing PHI for a radiology product — will require SOC2 + EU data residency options. They'll ask for a security questionnaire and DPA updates. I'll coordinate the call. :calendar:

Anika Patel: We can do SOC2 attestation and EU residency (region pin). For POC we need to confirm network isolation and whether logs contain PHI. Please share the security questionnaire link and the IP ranges for the POC.

Sofia Martin: Proposed quick ratecard snippet to discuss (internal):
```
Base committed token price: $0.012/token at 100k commit
Proposed ramp: 100k commit -> 300k commit over 8 weeks
Temporary promotional credit: 20% off committed unit price for first 4 weeks
Fallback: standard commit pricing after 8 weeks
POC Dedicated add-on: one-time setup fee $8k + daily GPU rate estimate pending
```

Liam O'Connor: That setup fee + 20% credit needs Deal Desk approval. If we can't get 20% we could offer 10% + extended payment terms or free 2-week POC. What's ARR on the existing account?

Sofia Martin: Current ARR ~$180k. Customer justification: latency and determinism for image analysis — Dedicated is a must for them.

DealDeskBot: Ticket created DD-4782 for approval request (submitter: Sofia Martin). Please provide ARR, proposed concession, and competitive / churn risk rationale.

Sofia Martin: Added details to DD-4782: ARR $180k, risk of churn if we don't deliver Dedicated POC + regional residency, competitive pressure from vendor X offering lower list price but no SOC2 / residency.

Raj Patel: I'll size the GPU footprint. Quick calc: for 2-week POC with 4 concurrent workers for model gpt-medium-ish equivalent, estimate ~320 GPU hours. ETA EOD with refined numbers and cost per GPU hour.

Anika Patel: Security ask: please complete questionnaire and include sample logs (redacted). We'll need Legal to update DPA for residency. Contact: legal@redwood.com.

Ben Lee: From Legal — we can do a DPA addendum and standard residency clause. No special indemnities unless customer insists; if they do, route to me. I'll review proposed special terms once uploaded.

Liam O'Connor: If Deal Desk approves, recommend structuring as: 20% promo credit for first 30 days OR 10% + 2-week free POC, 8-week ramp schedule, commit level 300k tokens/mo with re-eval at 6 months. Need approval by Friday COB to hit renewal timeline.

Sophie Nguyen: I'll schedule the renewal + POC kickoff call for Wed 10am PT and invite Security + Raj + Legal.

Emily Carter: I'll prepare the customer-facing renewal deck with the two pricing options and include POC scope. Will attach to DD-4782.

Sofia Martin: Thanks all — I'm pulling everything into one folder and will update DD-4782 with the final ask after Raj's capacity numbers. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can join Wed call.

Raj Patel: :thumbsup:
